title: 2026/138 Clinical Specialist Physiotherapist - Gynaecology SPC COE
description: The post-holder will deliver a specialist physiotherapy service, providing high quality, safe and timely care with an emphasis on access, choice, communication, cultural diversity for the ambulatory Gynaecology patients referred from Connolly Hospital and the Rotunda Hospital. The post will be divided between both the Rotunda Hospital and in the catchment of Connolly Hospital, based in the community. The successful candidate: **Purpose of the Gynaecological Post:** * To work with the Obstetrics/Gynaecological/Urogynaecological Consultants and relevant health care professionals in undertaking triage of ambulatory gynaecological referrals to ensure efficient and effective management of the waiting list and to improve the patient pathway of care. * To provide a first contact of care following triage of the referral and link back into the Gynaecology service as required. * To attend clinics or liaise with the relevant Consultant or Specialist Registrar. * To provide the physiotherapy advanced assessment, management and treatment of patients referred from the ambulatory gynaecology service as part of the National Women's and Infants Health Programme (NWHIP) and scheduled care services in the Rotunda Hospital and the catchment area of Connolly Hospital. This may be situated in the hospital or community facilities. * To provide advance practice in the management of pessary fitting and review according to relevant guidelines and under the governance of the Obstetric/Gynaecological teams. * To work within the multidisciplinary team ethos and liaise with staff to ensure effective communication takes place at all times. * Promote and ensure clinical effectiveness, a high standard of care following evidence based guidelines. * To evaluate and develop the clinical specialist role through clinical audit and research. * Provide expert clinical lead for Women's Health and Continence senior/physiotherapy colleagues. **Clinical practice** To provide an expert clinical service to the Women's Health and Continence service. * To ensure a high standard of physiotherapy assessment, treatment and management is provided for patients and that professional standards are adhered to. * Ensure the privacy and dignity of the patient is respected at all times. * Observe patient confidentiality. To undertake other duties within the hospital as specified by the Physiotherapy Manager, including maintaining ward competency level. To put in place evaluating mechanisms by continually auditing and evaluating the service to maximise effectiveness, efficiency and quality. **Education and Continuous Professional Development:** Lead, promote and ensure clinical electiveness through performance management, education, audit and research. Collect and analyse data to evaluate the effectiveness of treatment and upholding standards of care through clinical audit and research. Keep abreast of research and practice developments in relevant clinical areas by attending seminars, conferences and post graduate courses. Promote changes in work practices, procedures, techniques or technology having regard to the development of best practice and advanced practice in physiotherapy Communicate with other clinical specialists throughout the country and internationally to further develop clinical excellence and research. Act as a resource to other physiotherapist/colleagues regarding the management of complex cases both within the hospital and at a regional/national level. Contribute to a structured process for education of colleagues, undergraduates and other disciplines in the specialist area. Contribute towards continuing professional development activity programmes within the department. Serve on or advise such committees that may be set up relevant to this clinical specialty. Contribute to the forward planning and development of Gynaecological Clinical Pathways. **Working practice:** To be aware of resource management and contribute to business planning and continuous quality improvement related to the physiotherapy department and the specialist area. Maintain comprehensive and accurate patient and activity records in line with national documentation standards Adhere to clinic standards of practice and protocols for written communication with GP's and referral sources. Compile and prepare reports of a legal nature were necessary, based on the documented physiotherapeutic care of the patient. * Responsible for daily administrative tasks and overall caseload management for physiotherapy services. * Optimise the use of available resources and demonstrate innovation to sustain and enhance services. * Provide information on activity levels and statistics as may be required by the physiotherapy Manager. * Comply with department policies, procedures, protocols and guidelines. * Establish key working relationships and facilitate regular service and clinical meetings. * Comply with all mandatory training and national standards. * Undertake other responsibilities as agreed from time to time with the Physiotherapy Manager or other such persons to who he/she may be accountable to. The above job specification is not intended to be a comprehensive list of all duties involved and consequently, the post holder may be required to perform other duties as appropriate to the post which may be assigned to him/her from time to time and contribute to the development of the post while in office. Candidates for appointment must: **Essential:** Hold a Physiotherapy qualification recognised by the Physiotherapists Registration Board and be registered on the physiotherapy register maintained by the Physiotherapy Registration Board at CORU (proof required). Be qualified for 5 years, with 3 years in the clinical specialty of women's health. **Desirable:** Ability to use data management and statistical analysis software. Experience delivering services via virtual and telehealth systems. Active participation in professional bodies and working groups relevant to this post. **Essential requirements:** The requisite gynaecological clinical skills, knowledge and ability, including a high standard of suitability and professional ability for the proper discharge of the duties of the office. Evidence of continuous professional development in this area in the form of postgraduate qualifications, relevant courses and conferences. Evidence of clinical achievement and contribution to evolving practice in this area. Experience in the areas of clinical audit, quality improvement initiatives, practice development, teaching and research. A strong working knowledge of the Irish maternity setting and understanding of appropriate policies, strategies and clinical care programmes relevant to the role Is confident, self-motivated and reliable. Ability to be flexible and adaptable in line with the demands of a hospital service Ability to work as part of a team and independently. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Able to build and maintain effective working relationships with relevant stakeholders. Excellent presentation skills with the ability to present information in a clear and concise manner, at both individual and group level. Ability to apply behaviour change and motivational interview skills. Experienced in audit, evaluation, research, quality improvement and dissemination of results. Demonstrates a strong patient-centered ethos and takes pride in the quality of service delivered. Able to plan, review and adapt the service. Excellent problem solving, organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to plan and balance demands with responsibilities. Strong leadership skills to drive new service initiatives. Demonstrate dedication to maintaining CPD in this specialist area with a willingness to develop new skills where necessary. All Informal enquires in relation to this post should be directed to Ms. Grainne Wall, Physiotherapist Manager at Grainne.Wall@ROTUNDA.ie Applicants should include a current CV, cover letter, name and emails addresses of two recent referees. Please quote the relevant reference number. Applications to arrive not later than 10/11/2026

title: Actuarial Expert
description: The Allianz Group is a global financial services provider with services predominantly in the insurance and asset management business. Allianz SE, the parent company, is headquartered in Munich, Germany. Allianz has established a specialist Branch, Allianz SE Dublin Reinsurance Branch. The branch's premises are at Allianz House, Elmpark, Merrion Road, Dublin 4. **Job Description** We are looking for an Actuarial Expert to join our Corporate Actuarial team at Allianz Re in Dublin. Reporting to the Head of P&C Reserving, you will be part of a small, collaborative and highly professional team, fully integrated with all aspects of quarterly and annual reporting under IFRS 17 and Solvency II. This is an excellent opportunity for a nearly or newly qualified actuary to deepen their technical expertise in a global reinsurance environment, working with modern tools including ResQ, Unify, SAS and advanced Excel. **Key Responsibilities** * Perform reserving on IFRS 17 and Solvency II bases across assigned global reinsurance segments * Carry out underwriting risk capital calculations as part of the entity's Solvency II internal capital model * Contribute to quarterly roll-forward exercises and annual deep-dive reserve reviews * Support experience analysis and assumption setting for Life & Health and/or Property & Casualty lines * Assess reserve adequacy, monitor trends and emerging risks * Perform stress testing, sensitivity analysis and scenario modelling from both reserving and risk capital perspectives * Identify opportunities for model improvements and support their implementation * Communicate findings clearly to stakeholders across the business What We're Looking For **Required Qualifications & Experience** * Close to completing (or recently completed) fellowship of a recognised actuarial body (e.g. IFoA) * University degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics or a related quantitative discipline * 3+ years' experience in IFRS and/or Solvency II reserving, local regulatory reserving, or capital modelling in a reinsurance or insurance environment * Good understanding of IFRS 17 concepts; practical experience (e.g. in IFRS 17 testing or development) is a strong advantage Technical Skills * Programming and database proficiency, SAS and SQL are essential * Strong MS Excel skills including VBA and Power Query * Experience with DFA, risk capital or cashflow modelling would be an advantage Personal Attributes * Strong analytical mindset with excellent attention to detail * Clear and confident communicator, both written and verbal * Comfortable working independently and managing competing priorities * A collaborative team player who thrives in an international working environment * Structured approach to complex actuarial problems **Responsibilities** At Allianz Re, we are committed to embracing innovation and the responsible use of Artificial Intelligence to enhance our work. We particularly value candidates who demonstrate: * Curiosity and a proactive approach to learning new tools and methodologies * Awareness of AI-powered tools and their application in actuarial and data analysis * An interest in data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement What We Offer * Study support for actuarial professional examinations * Exposure to a diverse, global reinsurance portfolio * A supportive, close-knit team environment with direct access to senior leadership * Opportunities for professional growth within the wider Allianz Group * Modern tools and technology to support your work Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges, is what makes us a unique employer. Together we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and has the confidence to explore, to grow and to shape a better future for our customers and the world around us. At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. And the foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and nurtures a culture grounded in integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust. Join us **. Let's care for tomorrow.**

title: Architectural Technologist
description: **Architectural Technologist** **About Your New Employer** Join a well-established Dublin-based architectural studio with decades of experience delivering innovative, high-quality projects across the residential, commercial and interiors sectors. You will join a collaborative and design-led team working on a diverse portfolio of residential developments. The practice offers: * The opportunity to work on large-scale residential projects from concept through to completion. * A supportive and experienced team environment where your technical skills will be developed and valued. * Exposure to all stages of project delivery, including design development, technical detailing, construction and site coordination. * Excellent opportunities for professional growth and career progression. * The chance to work closely with experienced Associates, architects, consultants and contractors. **About Your New Job** As an Architectural Technologist, you will support the delivery of residential projects throughout the full project lifecycle. title: Founding Accountant
description: Solance is building a tech-enabled payments company. We are here for businesses that operate across multiple entities, jurisdictions and currencies, and for sectors that traditional banks generally overlook. Think family offices, internationally operating companies, corporate service providers and the clients they serve. We are going through the authorisation process with the Central Bank of Ireland, one of the most reputable banking jurisdictions in Europe, and we are only getting started. **Why this role exists** Most finance people inherit someone else's mess: the spreadsheet nobody understands, the close that takes two weeks because that is just how it has always been done. You will inherit none of that. We have built a strong business and a strong team ahead of launch, and the finance function is a blank page waiting for the right person to own it. That person builds the month-end close and the reporting from scratch, the way it should be done, and then automates it so it scales as fast as we do. **The role, in plain terms** Working alongside the CFO, you own the financial reporting of the business end to end. In practice: **Reporting and close** * Run the month-end close: journals, accruals, prepayments, balance sheet reconciliations and management accounts. * Prepare the group consolidation. * Prepare KPI reporting and the finance sections of the board packs and present the results to senior management. * Prepare the statutory financial statements and act as the day-to-day contact for our external auditors. **Regulatory and safeguarding** * Prepare and monitor regulatory returns and capital adequacy reporting under the Central Bank of Ireland's EMI framework. * Support the daily safeguarding reconciliation and the quarterly safeguarding review. **Treasury and tax** * Monitor cash positions and FX exposure across multiple currencies, in line with our operational payment flows. * Prepare and submit VAT and other tax returns. **Planning and improvement** * Support on the annual budget process and reporting against rolling forecasts. * Find cost efficiencies and drive automation across reporting and finance operations, working closely with our operations and technology teams. **What It Is Actually Like** We want to be straight with you. We are an early-stage business, still going through authorisation and heading into launch. Priorities shift, some weeks are busier than others, and you will often be the person working out how something should be done before you do it. If that sounds uncomfortable, this is probably not the right move. If it sounds like the fastest way you will learn, keep reading. **Requirements** **Who we are looking for** Someone who wants to build, not maintain. You have a real interest in financial services and in where payments and the movement of value are heading. You are curious, you ask when you are not sure, and you take ownership of your work from start to finish. When you spot something that could be done better, you do something about it. You communicate clearly with people inside and outside finance, and you want to grow. This role is built for someone with the ambition to become a future finance leader. **What You Bring** * Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CPA, CA(SA) or equivalent), with 0 to 3 years PQE. * Strong technical accounting and a process-driven way of working. * Experience in, or audit exposure to, EMIs, payment institutions or credit institutions. * Comfortable working too hard deadlines in an environment that keeps changing. * A clear and confident communicator. * A track record of improving processes, not just following them. **Nice to have** * Big 4 financial services audit training. * Exposure to asset and wealth management, capital markets or regulatory reporting. * Hands-on experience with cloud accounting systems, reporting tools or automation. **What Is In It For You** * You report directly to the CFO and have a real say in how the finance function gets built. * Exposure that would take years to gather in a larger organisation: reporting, regulatory capital, safeguarding, treasury, tax and audit, all inside one regulated EMI. * Direct access to the leadership team and the decisions that shape the business. * Room to grow. As the business scales, so do the role and the team around it. **Where you are based** This is a **Dublin role, in the office at least four days a week** . At our stage, it only works if you are in the room when the decisions get made. **Let us talk** If this reads like you, get in touch. And if it reads like someone you rate, send them our way, or send us the introduction. The best people in this world almost always come recommended, so a good word from you carries weight. **Benefits** * Private Healthcare * Pension * 25 days annual leave

project financial control. **Key Responsibilities** **Programme Cost Management & Commercial Control** * Support the implementation and continuous improvement of cost management procedures, systems contractual matters. * Support project risk reviews by identifying and assessing potential cost and commercial implications. * Assist in reviewing forecast final costs and cost reports, ensuring We´re one of the world's top three contract development and manufacturing companies for biopharmaceuticals. We enable our clients to research, develop and manufacture drugs from the concept phase to commercial manufacturing. Our mission is to accelerate and transform discovery, development, and manufacturing in the rapidly growing field of biologics to benefit patients worldwide. **Department Description** As a Manufacturing Elite, you’ll be joining an organization where people of all backgrounds and experiences are respected, and where we work together focused on changing lives. In this role, you will report to the Associate Director/Director Manufacturing in locations such as Wuxi, Hangzhou, Shijiazhuang China; Dundalk Ireland; Wuppertal, Germany. **Your Responsibilities:** * Participate in a structured early-career development program within Biologic Manufacturing, with potential rotations across Manufacturing, Engineering, Technology and Quality. * Gain hands-on experience in drug substance manufacturing, including upstream cell culture, downstream purification, buffer preparation and related manufacturing support activities across onsite facilities. * Receive technical training and soft-skills training delivered by internal Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), while learning and applying GMP, safety and quality standards in line with company values and culture. * Support site and cross-functional projects under the guidance of experienced leaders, engineers and project leads, with opportunities to develop communication, leadership, collaboration and problem-solving skills. * Support equipment package owners with vendor coordination, documentation review and equipment or process-related queries. * Provide day-to-day technical support and basic troubleshooting for manufacturing processes, equipment and automation systems, with guidance from senior team members. * Contribute to deviation and investigation activities by gathering data, supporting root cause analysis, assisting with experimental design or laboratory studies where applicable, and preparing reports or presentations. * Support change control activities, including documentation and close-out. * Assist with investigation trending and data analysis to identify recurring issues and improvement opportunities. * Participate in cross-functional teams to support manufacturing, process and environmental investigations as required. * Support audit preparation activities and respond to information requests as directed. * Support continuous improvement initiatives aimed at reducing cycle time, improving reliability and lowering operational costs. * Maintain accurate GMP records, databases and trackers; assist with data analysis, process mapping and modelling to identify trends, generate manufacturing insights and support improvement opportunities. * Embrace and be a role model of our PROUD culture. **Your Profile:** The ideal candidate for this position will have the following; **Qualifications:** * Highly qualified university graduates with a minimum Master degree in a Biology, Biomedical Science, Biotechnology, Chemical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Science, Engineering or a related discipline. * Candidates selected for the program have a history of strong academic achievement. * Candidates must be geographically mobile to take description: **Background:** Veolia is Ireland’s leading environmental services company. When you see the world as we do, you see the chance to help the world take better care of its resources, and help it become a better place for everyone. review and updating of spare part inventory of spares in clients site store. * Ensuring Engineering areas, in liaison with Contract Manager and Contract co-ordinator, facilities and equipment are kept in a clean, safe and serviceable condition, and general housekeeping highest standards are maintained. * Continuous improvement of contract delivery on site **Requirements for the role;** * **Senior Trades, City & Guilds or equivalent in Mechanical / Building Services engineering.** * **Engineering degree/diploma or equivalent, preferably mechanical/environmental, with two to three years post graduate experience, preferably in mechanical/building services, or** * **Marine qualification, with 2 to 4 years experience at sea.** ***Essential*** * Experience in the pharmaceutical, Biotech or food industry * Mechanical / Building Services / Utilities experience, 3 years minimum and good understanding of the basic fundamentals of the various utilities systems. * Pumps, HVAC Systems, Air Compressors, Boilers, Plant steam systems and ancillary services, (DHW /DCW /LPHW skids), Chillers, Cooling Towers, Clean steam Boilers, Purified Water Systems, WFI Water Systems, CIP systems, Refrigeration Systems, Process gases * Building Management Systems (Scada) * Good understanding of Preventive Maintenance / Corrective Maintenance Systems. * Familiarity with Predictive Maintenance (CBM) techniques and their benefits. * Worked within a Computerized Maintenance Management (CMMS) Work Order system environment. description: **Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. below and become a part of the extraordinary Eurofins network.** **Job Description** **Unfortunately, we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.** **This is a full time, 8 Month Fixed Term Contract, working 4 days on 4 days off, 07:00 - 19:00.** As a Microbiology Analyst you will work in a cross functional team to support the Microbiology Quality Control testing function, ensuring compliance with cGMP. **Job Responsibilities** * You will carry out environmental monitoring activities within GMP cleanroom and manufacturing environments, including viable and non-viable particulate monitoring, water and gas system monitoring, and pharmaceutical water system sampling and management. * You will perform a range of microbiological analyses including bioburden, endotoxin, microbial identification, Biological Indicator, BacT/ALERT, sterility, growth promotion, and other laboratory sampling and testing activities to support client and regulatory requirements. * You will review, trend, and interpret microbiological and analytical data, ensuring all results, documentation, and laboratory records are completed accurately, compliantly, and in line with GMP standards and client procedures. * You will support investigations relating to deviations, provide technical expertise to identify root causes and solutions, contribute to protocol and report preparation, and assist in the continuous improvement of quality, service, and laboratory processes. * You will collaborate closely with clients and colleagues, providing regular project updates, delivering exceptional customer service, maintaining strong working relationships, and ensuring all activities are conducted with integrity, quality, and regulatory compliance in mind. * You will maintain a safe, organised, and audit-ready laboratory environment, keep training and documentation up to date, support the development of team members through training and knowledge sharing, and provide flexible operational support across the wider Eurofins team as required. **Qualifications** **What skills, qualifications and experiences you will hold as an Microbiology Analyst** * You will hold a degree in Microbiology or a related scientific discipline and possess at least one year of experience within a pharmaceutical, GMP-regulated, or similarly controlled laboratory environment. * You will have academic and/or practical environmental monitoring (EM) experience, along with a strong understanding of cGMP principles and the requirements for working effectively within a regulated laboratory setting. * You will have the ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, meet established timelines, and remain adaptable when responding to changing business and customer requirements. * You will have excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build strong working relationships, collaborate effectively with colleagues and clients, and communicate technical information clearly and accurately. * You will have strong organisational, documentation, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively under pressure, quickly learn new processes, and contribute to solutions as part of a collaborative team environment. * You will have a customer-focused mindset, a passion for quality and continuous improvement, and a proven track record of delivering accurate, high-quality results while supporting the goals of a dynamic and growing Eurofins operation. ******Additional Information****** At Eurofins we are growing, innovating and always learning. We celebrate the achievements of our employees through annual long service awards, recognise our colleagues special life events. **As a Eurofins employee you will benefit from:** * We offer exceptional opportunities for career growth, within a friendly and supportive team. As well as a competitive salary, pension and associated benefits you will enjoy an unrivalled working environment, including an active social calendar and subsidised canteen, all while working in a start of the art client facility- a leading biotechnology company * Fantastic developmental opportunities and career progression pathways such as leadership, training, compliance and Subject Media Expert. * Full Benefits Package including:- + Pension + Private Medical Insurance + Income protection and life assurance + Annual discretionary bonus + Birthday Holiday entitlement * Exciting Eurofins Incentives: Employee Activity Committee (EAC), Equality Driving Excellence (EDE), significant Reward and Recognition programme Opportunity to benefit from Eurofins Operational Development training platform, plus potential support for part-time training (relevant to the position) * Full use of the canteen facilities and barista on the client site * Free parking onsite and onsite electric charging * Additional annual leave days with continued service * The opportunity to work on life saving products **What Happens Next** Our people are the backbone of what we do, so it's incredibly important we find the right individuals to join us. As a potential new recruit you'll be invited to meet the team in the form of an assessment centre or a staged interview process dependent on the role and it's requirements, this will give you the opportunity to see what working for Eurofins is really like and enable us to get you know your key skills and strengths. **Your data** As part of any recruitment process, the company collects and processes personal data relating to job applicants. Eurofins network of companies believe in strength and innovation through diversity, being an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique. **For more information about Eurofins PSS® please visit our** **website** **and watch a message below from our Global Head, Beth Di Paolo.**

RIAI Registered Architect: Technical Design & Delivery (5+ Years’ Experience) Some architects are happiest at concept stage; this role is for those who come alive once the task of making it buildable, and building it, begins. Horan Rainsford Architects is an established Blackrock practice, working since 2008 across the hotel, multi-unit residential, office and educational fit-out sectors. We are small enough that you will work directly with the directors and see your details built and established enough that the projects are substantial. **The Role** You will lead projects through technical design, tender and construction: resolving the detail, writing the specification, running the design team, and administering the contract on site. You will be the person contractors and consultants turn to for answers, and the one to ensure the design intent is carried through to completion. #### **Job Requirements** **What We Are Looking For** * RIAI Registered Architect, with at least five years’ post-graduate experience on commercial or multi-unit residential projects * A strong preference for the detail design and construction stages, with a real understanding of how a building goes together * A sound working knowledge of the Building Regulations and Technical Guidance Documents * Experience leading design teams and administering building contracts, including site inspections, RFIs, instructions and certification * Experience of the Building Control (Amendment) Regulations, and of acting as or supporting the Assigned Certifier, will be an advantage * Proficiency in Revit; and * Clear, concise written and verbal communication, with the confidence to hold a position with a contractor **What We Offer** * Competitive salary, commensurate with experience, with an annual performance bonus * Pension scheme * Paid RIAI membership * Employee Assistance Programme * Bike to Work scheme * Project leadership on substantial projects, working directly with the directors * Varied work across hotel, residential, office and education sectors * A small, collaborative team in Blackrock, close to the DART **How to Apply** Please apply by email only to Brian Rainsford (brian@horanrainsford.ie), with: * Your CV * Two or three of your own construction details, ideally that have been built * A short note, no more than half a page, describing a technical problem you faced on site or with a contractor, and how you resolved it Renders and 3D visuals are not required. Applications without the details and note will not be considered. All applications will be treated in strict confidence.

title: Registered Nurse

**The staff nurse will:** * Be competent to deal with any allegation, suspected or confirmed abuse of any resident in accordance with the Safeguarding Vulnerable Adults Policy * Follow appropriate title: Reinsurance Underwriter / Actuary

Allianz Re Dublin dac is Allianz's specialist subsidiary for reinsurance business, based at Allianz House, Elmpark, Merrion Road, Dublin 4. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges, is what makes us a unique employer. Together we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and has the confidence to explore, to grow and to shape a better future for our customers and the world around us. At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations. Join us **. Let's care for tomorrow.**

title: Research Assistant - Electrophysiology
description: Mater Private Network is seeking a highly motivated **Research Assistant** to join the **Cardiovascular Research Institute Dublin (CVRI)** and support our growing Electrophysiology (EP) research programme. This is an exciting opportunity to gain hands-on experience in clinical research, work alongside leading cardiologists and researchers, and contribute to studies that improve patient care and shape the future of cardiovascular medicine. The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting clinical trials and maintaining the Electrophysiology Outcomes Registry, working closely with research nurses, principal investigators and the wider multidisciplinary team. **About The Role** As a Research Assistant, you will support the day-to-day delivery of academic and industry-sponsored research studies while ensuring the highest standards of research governance, data quality and patient care. This role offers a unique opportunity to develop expertise in clinical trials, cardiovascular research, data management and outcomes analysis within a busy and innovative healthcare environment. Key Responsibilities * Assist with the delivery of Electrophysiology clinical research studies from recruitment through to follow-up * Screen potential participants for study eligibility * Coordinate and support participant study visits * Collect and accurately enter research data into study databases * Extract data from patient records and hospital systems * Support research documentation and prepare study files for monitoring visits, audits and inspections * Ensure all research activities are conducted in accordance with ICH-GCP, HPRA and EU regulatory requirements * Maintain participant confidentiality and data protection standards at all times Electrophysiology Registry & Data Management * Support the collection and management of data for the Electrophysiology Outcomes Registry * Conduct retrospective reviews of electrophysiology datasets * Prepare reports and presentations for Electrophysiology team meetings * Assist with statistical analysis and interpretation of research data * Contribute to the development of scientific abstracts, posters and publications **Essential Qualifications** * BSc degree in Biological Sciences, Health Sciences or a related discipline * Excellent written and verbal communication skills * Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail * Proficient in Microsoft Office applications including Word, Excel and PowerPoint * Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team * Willingness to undertake training in: * Phlebotomy * Vital signs assessment * ECG acquisition * Biological sample processing and shipment Desirable Experience * Clinical research experience * Experience working in a healthcare or clinical environment * Experience with data collection, management and analysis * Knowledge of research databases * Qualification or experience in statistics or biostatistics * Good Clinical Practice (GCP) certification Salary & Benefits **Salary:** €31,462 - €41,443 (aligned with IUA Research Assistant salary scale and dependent on experience) **Annual Leave:** 26 days per annum (pro-rata) Additional benefits include: * Pension Scheme * Critical Illness Cover * Financial support for education and professional development * Staff Care Services Programme * Discounted pharmacy rates * Subsidised staff restaurant * Discounted inpatient and outpatient treatment rates * Opportunity to contribute to nationally and internationally recognised cardiovascular research **About Mater Private Network** Mater Private Network is one of Ireland's leading private healthcare providers and is committed to delivering exceptional patient care through clinical excellence, research, innovation and education. The Cardiovascular Research Institute Dublin (CVRI) plays a central role in advancing cardiovascular medicine and improving patient outcomes through high-quality clinical research. This position offers a unique opportunity to contribute directly to pioneering research within a world-class Electrophysiology service. **Mater Private Network is an equal opportunities employer.** #INDA

title: Resident Housing Officer
description: **Why Choose Clúid?** At Clúid Housing, we believe that success is achieved through our dedicated and passionate team. title: TEAM MEMBER
description: At Sprout, our Team Members are at the heart of what we do. You’re one of the people our customers come back to see, as much as they come back for the food. It’s a fast-paced, hands-on role where you’ll serve great food, create warm customer experiences, and work with the team to keep the restaurant running brilliantly. **Reporting to:** Restaurant Leader **Contract:** Full-time **Pay:** €14.15–€14.50 per hour, depending on experience and role **What You Get** * Free great food on every shift * Team discount across all Sprout locations * 50% off for you and three friends when you're off * Real opportunities to grow, we love promoting from within * Learning and development through Sprout University * Free online Wellbeing and mental health support * Regular team socials and celebrations * A fun, friendly team that genuinely cares **What You’ll Do** * Welcome customers, take orders and help create a warm, friendly experience * Prepare and serve fresh food to Sprout standards, making sure every dish looks and tastes great * Learn all areas of the service line, including till, toppings and mix * Keep the restaurant clean, organised, stocked and ready for service * Learn our menu so you can answer questions and recommend dishes confidently * Follow food safety, hygiene and health & safety standards * Work closely with the team to keep service running smoothly, especially during busy periods **You’ll probably love working at Sprout if...** * You like a bit of buzz and don’t mind music playing while you work * You enjoy being around people and chatting to customers * You’re happy jumping in wherever the team needs you * You’re reliable, turn up on time and take pride in doing a good job * You’re curious, open to feedback and want to keep learning * You like being part of a team where people genuinely look out for each other You don’t need previous experience, we’ll teach you everything you need to know. title: Treasury Assistant
description: **Winthrop Technologies** is a dedicated data centre delivery partner providing turnkey solutions to our clients, headquartered in Dublin and delivering throughout Europe. We specialise in providing turnkey data centre solutions, providing services from design through to construction across the full range of civil, structural, architectural, mechanical and electrical services, as well as commissioning. Winthrop has grown to become the leading and most trusted company in our sector and is the only dedicated Data Centre delivery partner in Europe. We are currently constructing multiple turnkey data centre projects in seven different European countries, equating to over 430MW of IT load in flight. Due to continuous growth, we are pleased to announce that we are currently seeking a **Treasury Assistant** to join our team in **Head Office, Ballymount, Dublin 22** . This candidate must be detail-oriented, energetic and an enthusiastic individual who will support the Treasury & Banking Lead to work on all aspects of cash, banking and debt of the business. The successful candidate's position will be expanded to cover areas of cash and debt function as the person develops into the role and embeds process management, automation and reporting capability within the day-to-day deliverables. You will have strong communication, IT and organisational skills, with the ability to work effectively as part of a dynamic team in a fast-paced construction environment. **Responsibilities:** **Preparation and processing of payments on banking payment platforms** * Payment input for manual payments and payment files. * Progression, approval of new payees and progressing payment approval as required. **Cash balance reporting and review** * Bank account balance update and scheduling details of payments and receipts going through the bank accounts. * Comprehensive reporting of cash balances on a periodic basis. * Run bank statements and resolve payment and transaction queries. **Cash forecasting:** * Work closely with accounting teams, payroll teams, AR and AP to ensure accurate cashflow forecasting on a periodic basis. * Report on actual versus forecast on a weekly and monthly basis. * Prepare and circulate rolling cash forecasts based on existing outstanding balances and forecast projected revenues and payments. **Treasury back office and middle office duties:** * Confirmation of Treasury deals with banks for Money Market deals (deposits and loans) and Foreign Exchange (FX) deals. * Reporting on interest income and foreign exchange positions. * Assist the Treasury and Banking Lead with front office work / placing treasury deals with banks (putting funds on deposit etc). **Bank account set-up:** * Bank account maintenance (account opening, closing, bank mandate updates etc). * Support new bank account opening as required. * AML/KYC and other ancillary information requests from the banks and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements in line with established banking structures. **Ad hoc treasury projects** * Process Documentation and providing / updating SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) for routine tasks. * Contribute and support the automation agenda with a view to optimising the automation of financial and operational reporting. **Requirements** **Successful Candidate** * 3rd level degree in Finance or Accounting or a similar degree. Recognised Treasury or Accounting professional certification is an advantage * Minimum 1 year's experience in a Treasury environment (Banking or Corporate) is an advantage. * Proficient use of Microsoft Suite including Excel, Word and Outlook. * Previous use of NetSuite ERP and AIB IBB banking system is an advantage but not required. * Strong financial understanding, with some proficiency in financial modelling / forecasting. * Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Demonstrable analytical skills. **Benefits** * Opportunity to work on some of Europe's most prestigious data centre projects * A collaborative and supportive work environment * Excellent opportunities for professional development and career progression * Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package * Newly refurbished, modern office facilities * Contemporary kitchen and dining area for employees * Complimentary fresh fruit, tea, coffee, and filtered water provided

title: Van Driver
description: **Company Description** Bellew Group is an independent electrical wholesaler with 29 branches and continued growth across its network. The company is strongly customer-focused, providing reliable service and tailored solutions to a wide range of clients. Team members are experienced and committed to meeting customer needs efficiently and professionally. Bellew Group offers a supportive work environment that values collaboration, safety, and long-term relationships with both employees and customers. **Role Description** This is a full-time Van Driver role based in Greater Dublin, structured as a hybrid position where some administrative tasks and coordination can be completed from home. The Van Driver will be responsible for safely loading, transporting, and delivering electrical wholesale products to customers and branches in a timely manner. Daily tasks include planning delivery routes, checking delivery notes and stock accuracy, maintaining vehicle cleanliness and basic safety checks, and providing courteous, professional service at each drop-off and collection. The role also involves liaising with branch staff and customers, handling delivery documentation, and using basic digital tools to confirm deliveries or update schedules. Occasional warehouse support, such as assisting with order picking and organizing stock, may be required. **Qualifications** * Valid driver’s license appropriate for van driving and a strong track record of safe, responsible driving. * Ability to plan routes, manage time effectively, and follow delivery schedules with attention to detail. * Good communication and customer service skills to interact professionally with customers and colleagues. * Basic digital literacy for using smartphones or tablets to manage delivery information and documentation. * Reliable, punctual, and able to work independently as well as part of a team. * Physical ability to handle loading and unloading goods safely, in line with manual handling guidelines. * Experience in wholesale, distribution, or logistics environments is beneficial but not essential. * Familiarity with the Greater Dublin area and surrounding routes is an advantage.

title: Warehouse & Administrative Assistant
description: Topcon Positioning Group is headquartered in Livermore, California, USA (topconpositioning.com). We design, manufacture and distribute productivity tools for developing a brighter future. Whether cultivating the earth or building upon it, Topcon brings innovation in workflow automation and seamless connectivity of data to construction, geopositioning and agriculture industries focused on developing a sustainable tomorrow. Topcon is a tech company committed to delivering innovative solutions and fostering an inclusive, respectful, and transparent workplace. We believe in equal opportunities and fair pay practices. Learn more about working with us at topconcareers.com **TOPCON Positioning Ireland** **is looking for a** **Warehouse & Administrative Assistant** **in Dublin – Ireland – Office based** **Job Purpose** The Warehouse & Administrative Assistant plays a key operational role in ensuring the smooth flow of goods, information, and customer support across the business. This hybrid position supports both warehouse logistics and administrative processes by accurately receiving and booking stock, preparing and dispatching orders, and maintaining up‑to‑date records in SAP and courier systems. The role also provides essential administrative support by processing sales orders, coordinating delivery updates, and managing customer enquiries through phone, email, and walk‑ins. By combining hands‑on warehouse activity with efficient administrative coordination, this position helps maintain high service levels for internal teams, customers, and repair operations. **Core Job Duties** **Administration** * Process sales orders from sales staff/end users * Adding in customer PO * Adding in Sales Employee * Adding in contact number for delivery * Follow up with TEP on outstanding deliveries and communicating this to sales staff and customers * Manage customer phone & email queries through ticketing system * Getting POD’s for drop shipments and direct deliveries, upload to sap * Dealing with customer walk in’s for repairs or accessory sales **Warehouse** * Check off deliveries & book them into stock * Pick & pack deliveries * Book deliveries on courier portal * Book repairs on SAP **Scope and Impact** The Warehouse & Administrative Assistant operates across two core business functions—warehouse operations and customer-facing administration. The role spans the full order lifecycle, from receiving and booking stock to processing sales orders, coordinating deliveries, and managing customer enquiries. It requires daily interaction with internal teams (sales, logistics, repairs), external partners (couriers, TEP), and end customers. The position works primarily on-site and is responsible for maintaining accurate data in SAP, courier portals, and ticketing systems to ensure operational continuity. **Ensures operational accuracy and efficiency** by maintaining precise stock records, booking deliveries correctly, and supporting timely dispatch of orders. **Improves customer satisfaction** through prompt handling of phone, email, and walk‑in enquiries, clear communication on delivery status, and efficient processing of repairs and accessory sales. **Supports revenue flow** by accurately processing sales orders, ensuring all required information is captured, and enabling smooth fulfilment. **Strengthens internal coordination** by providing sales teams with up‑to‑date delivery information, PODs, and issue resolution through the ticketing system. **Reduces operational delays and errors** through diligent follow‑up with TEP, proactive communication, and consistent data accuracy in SAP. **Enhances the reliability of warehouse operations** by ensuring stock is correctly received, recorded, and prepared for dispatch, contributing to overall supply chain performance. **Education/Experience** **Minimum Requirements for job:** Leaving Certificate (NFQ Level 4–5) or equivalent is required Experience in logistics, supply chain, business administration, or office management. SAP, inventory management, or customer service is beneficial **Warehouse Operations** **Technical / Professional Skills** Competent in stock handling, goods receiving, order picking/packing, and general warehouse workflow. **Systems & Software** * Proficient in SAP for booking repairs, updating orders, and uploading PODs. * Comfortable using courier booking portals for dispatch management. * Experience with ticketing systems for managing customer queries. * Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office, especially Outlook, Excel, and Word. **Order Processing** Ability to accurately process sales orders, input customer POs, assign sales employees, and capture delivery contact details. **Data Accuracy & Record Keeping** High attention to detail when entering stock, updating delivery information, and maintaining system accuracy. **Customer Service** Skilled in handling customer phone calls, emails, and walk‑ins with professionalism and clarity. **Communication & Coordination** Effective at liaising with sales teams, couriers, and TEP to resolve delivery issues and provide timely updates. **Time Management & Multitasking** Able to balance warehouse duties with administrative tasks in a fast‑paced environment. **Problem Solving** Capable of identifying issues with deliveries, stock discrepancies, or customer queries and resolving them efficiently. **Physical Requirements** working in a warehouse environment, lift, carry, and move items, ability to move between warehouse and office areas throughout the day. **Working Conditions: Hybrid warehouse and office environment, On‑site role** , interaction with couriers, sales teams, customers, and walk‑in visitors Topcon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, genetic information, or other legally protected status.
